jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Technical Developer, Global Apparel Graphics - PCC
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH


The Graphics PCC (Product Creation Center) Apparel Development team values craft, speed, and precision. The Senior Developer reports to the Manager of Development and partners closely with Design, Product Management, Materials, Color, Quality, and Manufacturing. Together, they turn bold ideas into finished products that deliver purpose, performance, and consistent execution at scale.


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR


The team is looking for a Senior Developer who pairs deep technical expertise with creative instinct and a passion for T-shirts and the full range of graphic embellishment techniques. This person translates bold design intent into scalable, production-ready products while protecting the details that make the product distinctive. As a trusted resource in graphic embellishment, they bring hands-on screen-printing expertise and a disciplined commitment to quality, consistency, and manufacturability.


They connect concept, fit, materials, graphics, and manufacturing realities to make smart decisions for athletes, consumers, and the business. They listen, communicate clearly, and bring teams together around solutions. They adapt quickly, seek feedback, and take ownership of the work, raising the standard for craft, collaboration, and inclusion.


·  A minimum of 3 years directly relevant work experience

·  Bachelor’s degree in apparel design, textile science, or a related field. Will accept any combination of education, experience, or training

·  5 years of technical development and/or design experience in the apparel industry

·  Demonstrate deep expertise in apparel screen-printing and graphic embellishment techniques, along with proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

·  Experience with CAD pattern design software such as Optitex and 3D apparel tools such as CLO or Browzwear is preferred

·  Ability to travel up to 10%


WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON


You’ll own the technical execution of an assigned Apparel category from concept through production, connecting product requirements, development decisions, and production readiness at every stage. You’ll protect the design intent while solving for quality, manufacturability, speed, and consistency.


·  Manage assigned styles for the Apparel Graphics PCC Development team from concept through production readiness, coordinating decisions, dependencies, and deliverables across the Product Creation Center

·  Create and maintain accurate, factory-ready tech packs, including measurements, construction sketches, graphic placements, and execution details

·  Request, track, review, and provide actionable feedback on physical and digital prototypes; lead focused prototype review sessions that drive decisions and next steps

·  Build clear product specifications and construction standards that strengthen manufacturability, quality, and consistency across production

·  Navigate development gates, calendars, and key milestones, anticipating risks and driving solutions to keep products on track for production readiness

·  Communicate progress, trade-offs, risks, and solutions clearly across a fast-paced, highly collaborative cross-functional team

We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Candidate Accommodation Request Form.
